title: The Telecom Backbone Diameter
statement:
A national telecommunications provider deploys an unweighted tree network connecting V relay hubs numbered 1 to V via exactly V - 1 bidirectional fiber optic links.

The latency between any two hubs is directly proportional to the number of link hops between them.
The network diameter is defined as the maximum hop distance between any pair of hubs in the network.

Calculate the diameter of the tree network.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer V.
Next V - 1 lines: Two integers u and v indicating a fiber optic link between hubs u and v.
outputFormat: Print the diameter of the tree.

sampleCases.explanation: Longest path is between hub 4 (or 5) and hub 3: 4 -> 2 -> 1 -> 3 (3 hops).
